reason: Add native Erome album intake, previously unsupported: explicit album identity, partial ordered web_media membership, per-URL attachment/archive identity, and traversal-only timestamps. Existing source adapters, capture/execution contracts, queued policies, producer schema 19, receipts and archive entries retain their semantics. Erome position-based keys are preserved but never used as native completion proof. Shared contract fixtures and real pinned extractor tests cover ordering, failed-file retry and invalid evidence.
